display_name: Zero-knob same-day early-server-block range break long, intraday flat (v2; execution contract frozen)
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1 as stamped by the Vantage terminal clock in xauusd_data.csv, the high–low range of server hours 1–8 on a calendar day is a day-local object. A long-only rule that enters only if flat when a later bar (server hour in 9..15) closes above that same-day early-block high, with fixed ATR SL/TP and force-flat at server hour 16, has no free parameters. Any edge must come from same-day early-range expansion after early-block compression under Standard STP spread costs. Hours are pure server labels — not claimed Tokyo/Asia wall-clock or London–NY overlap.

clock_contract.source: MqlRates time via Mt5ArchBridge TimeToString; fetch_data tags as UTC without conversion
clock_contract.hours_present_develop_note: develop bars show server hours 1..23 (hour 0 typically absent); early block uses 1..8

rule.entry: once per calendar day: if flat and server hour in entry_allowed_hours and early_block_high is defined for that day and close > early_block_high, enter long at that bar close
rule.early_block_high: max(high) over bars on the same calendar day with hour in early_block_hours_server; undefined until all early-block hours that exist for the day have been observed (use max of bars seen with hour in 1..8 once hour>=9 or once a bar with hour in 9..15 is reached — fixed: compute running max of highs for hours 1..8 as they print; break may fire only at hours 9..15 using the early-block high accumulated from hours 1..8 of that day (if no early bars, no trade that day)
rule.exit: SL/TP or force flat at close of bar with hour>=flat_hour same day; no overnight

null.algorithm: For each calendar day with m bars: (1) ref_0 = open[0], ref_j = close[j-1] for j>0; (2) inc_j = (open,high,low,close)/ref_j componentwise; (3) circularly rotate the m increments by k∈{0..m-1}; (4) rebuild continuous OHLC path from the original day open by chaining rotated increments so each bar unit's open/ref and true-range/ref ratios are preserved as a multiset. Timestamps and spreads remain fixed. No absolute-price day-block paste; no foreign-hour geometry on a new close.
null.notes: Canonical session null for protocol 2.2. Required because early-block high and break use within-day path geometry.

explicitly_forbidden: inspect develop grid metrics before this charter is git-committed and matches HEAD
rename or filter closed families (bb_rsi, Donchian, prior_day_high_break, tod_london_ny_flat, server_hour_window_flat)
claim Tokyo/Asia or London–NY wall-clock identity without external offset proof
CLI null overrides under sealed cycle
dispositional run with dirty tracked protocol/family/cost/charter/registry files
holdout selection or retune after screen
deviate from execution_contract (ATR estimator, exit priority, same-bar exit after close entry)
use v1 charter for dispositional runs after SUPERSEDED

supersedes.reason: v1 fixed ATR period and SL/TP multiples but left ATR estimator, entry/exit sequencing, same-bar SL/TP priority, post-entry exit lag, and lot rounding unfrozen (hidden implementation knobs). v2 freezes the conservative house execution contract explicitly.

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 only; no same-bar open entry from open of signal bar

atr.formula: TR ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False).mean() — MetaTrader-style Wilder via EWM
atr.value_used_at_entry: atr[i] on signal bar close (no lag beyond causal TR/EWM definition)
forbidden_alternatives: standard EMA of TR with different alpha convention unless identical to Wilder alpha=1/14
using atr[i-1] for SL distance when entering at close[i] (house convention uses atr[i])

entry.signal: evaluated at bar close of index i
entry.fill: enter at close[i] when signal true and flat

exit.first_eligible_bar: i+1 (exits begin next bar after close-entry; no same-bar exit)
exit.sl_fill: exit at sl price when low[j] <= sl
exit.tp_fill: exit at tp price when high[j] >= tp (only if stop not hit first)
exit.time_flat_fill: exit at close[j] when hour[j] >= flat_hour_server
exit.end_of_series: if still in position on last bar, force close at last close with trade_cost already charged

sizing.raw_lots: risk_cash / (stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE) with risk_cash = balance * risk_pct
sizing.skip_if: lots < min_lot OR stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE * min_lot > risk_cash

execution_contract.house_convention_source: scripts/xau_family_server_hour_window_flat.py simulate() sequencing (stop before TP; entry at close; exit checks before entry on same bar for open positions)
execution_contract.note_on_exit_vs_entry_same_bar: Open positions are evaluated for exit at the start of each bar iteration before new entries. Because entry fills at close[i], the first bar that can exit is j=i+1 (exit checks use bar j OHLC).
